decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.6944. Series context: trend strength 0.8667 and seasonal strength 0.4981; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.267); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 9.501.
